newsitem.title: CHILE: Chilean economic growth up five percent September.
newsitem.headline: Chilean economic growth up five percent September.

text.p: Chile's Imacec economic growth index climbed a moderate 5.0 percent in September over the same month last year, the Central Bank reported.
The new figure brought growth in the first nine months of the year to 7.0 percent over the same period last year, the bank said in its biweekly report.
The Imacec, a kind of preliminary barometer of gross domestic product growth, rose 5.7 percent last month.
The September figure was on the low end of most expectations and gave a new sign that economic growth was slowing in Chile due to restrictive Central Bank monetary policies.
